summary: I read the inventory reservation path in packages/modules/inventory/src/services/inventory-module.ts. ensureInventoryLevels, when validateQuantityAtLocation is set (as createReservationItems_ does), checks each reservation input's quantity against the level's available_quantity one at a time and never sums inputs that share an (inventory_item_id, location_id). A batch with several lines on the same item can therefore pass even when their total exceeds stock. I submitted attempt 1 (multi-line same-item race, expecting no_oversell to fail). Its run result was not returned to me, so the claim rests on the code reading, not on a observed failure. I did not investigate the process-local lock or the stale reserved_quantity write (createReservationItems_ writes an absolute value from an earlier read), so those are untested.
